What Is Home Office Design?

A home office is more than a desk in a spare room. It is a purposeful setting for productive work, physical comfort and sustained focus.

We bring layout, ergonomic furniture, lighting, storage, connectivity, privacy and style into one plan. The result works professionally without feeling separate from the home.

ComfortFocusDaily flow

What We Deliver

Eight practical decisions create a workspace that feels clear, comfortable and ready for your working day.

Scroll through the complete home office scope.

01

Layout & Space Planning

Desk position, circulation and work zones shaped around the room.

02

Desk & Workstation Design

A practical surface sized for your equipment and daily tasks.

03

Ergonomic Seating

Supportive seating chosen for posture, comfort and long sessions.

04

Task & Ambient Lighting

Focused desk light balanced with comfortable room lighting.

05

Storage & Organization

Files, books and equipment kept close without visual clutter.

06

Connectivity & Power Planning

Sockets, charging, data and cable routes placed where they are needed.

07

Privacy & Focus Design

Visual and acoustic choices that reduce everyday distractions.

08

Style & Decorative Elements

Colour, art and texture that connect the office to your home.

Our Design Process

Five clear stages take the workspace from requirements to a finished visual package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss your work pattern, equipment, meetings and preferred atmosphere.

02

Site Measurement

We record the room, openings, power points and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Workstation position, storage and circulation come together.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Desk, chair, lighting, finishes and storage are coordinated.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive drawings, selections and clear 3D views.

Consultation to final design packageTypically 1–2 weeks from consultation to final design package.

Home Office Design FAQs

Straight answers on space, comfort, cost and how the room can work.

The initial consultation is free. Design consultation starts from around PKR 10,000, while full packages range from PKR 15,000–35,000 depending on size and complexity.

A compact work nook can begin at around 6×8 feet. A comfortable dedicated office is usually 10×12 feet or more.

Ergonomics, lighting and workflow layout matter most. Together they support comfort, focus and an easier working day.

We use fitted storage, compact desks and flexible furniture so the room works well without feeling crowded.

A typical home office takes 1–2 weeks from consultation to the final design package.

Yes. We plan flattering light, a calm camera background, acoustics and seating for occasional meetings.
